concepts.gloss_en: The 'luminaries of fire' — the harsh/judgment forces (contrasted with מאורי אור, luminaries of light = Shabbat)
The subjugation/being-subdued of the luminaries of fire (a state/action about מאורי אש, brought about by mourning the Temple) — not the entity itself

members.note: representative; describes the act 'מכניע מאורי אש' — an action/state about מאורי אש, distinct per rule 4

notes: Per rule 4, an action/state about X (subjugating the fires) is a distinct concept from X (the fires themselves). Kept separate despite token overlap.
